description: This is a PHP source file defining a class 'ConfigurationProvider' within the namespace 'Aws\Endpoint\UseDualstackEndpoint'. The class provides various static methods to create configuration providers for AWS endpoints, specifically handling the 'use dual stack endpoint' option through environment variables, configuration files, and fallback defaults. It appears to be part of an SDK for AWS services, focusing on configuring endpoint options dynamically.
